doc: THE closed list of reason codes for each judgment head (atom_label_judgments.reason). A reason is one short code from its head's list, or empty; never a sentence. The WHY goes in the note. parser-os trains `<relation>_reason` only on a listed code (human_labels._judgment_rows), and moves any other reason text to the front of the note's WHY. Platform-infra vendors this file as azure-function-api/shared/judgment-reasons.json and checks every save against it, saving a sentence into the note rather than the reason. The parser's own reason on a card (a conflict's edge rule, a facility's deterministic_fallback) is provenance shown on the card, not a judgment reason, and is not listed. Sources: judgment-cards-common skill section 4, and the money, places-and-pairs, rules, dropped and questions skills.
